tools.description_excerpt: Navigate to a specified URL and load the page in memory so it can be reused later for info extraction.
tools.name: goto

tools.description_excerpt: Alias for goto. Navigate to a specified URL and load the page in memory.
tools.name: navigate

tools.description_excerpt: Get the page content in markdown format. If a url is provided, it navigates to that url first.
tools.name: markdown

tools.description_excerpt: Extract all links in the opened frame. If a url is provided, it navigates to that url first.
tools.name: links

tools.description_excerpt: Evaluate JavaScript in the current page context. If a url is provided, it navigates to that url first.
tools.name: evaluate

tools.description_excerpt: Alias for evaluate. Evaluate JavaScript in the current page context.
tools.name: eval

tools.description_excerpt: Get the page content as a simplified semantic DOM tree for AI reasoning. If a url is provided, it navigates to that url first.
tools.name: semantic_tree

tools.description_excerpt: Get detailed information about a specific node by its backend node ID. Returns tag, role, name, interactivity, disabled state, value, input type, placeholder, href, checked state, and select options.
tools.name: nodeDetails

tools.description_excerpt: Extract interactive elements from the opened frame. If a url is provided, it navigates to that url first.
tools.name: interactiveElements

tools.description_excerpt: Extract structured data (like JSON-LD, OpenGraph, etc) from the opened frame. If a url is provided, it navigates to that url first.
tools.name: structuredData

tools.description_excerpt: Detect all forms on the page and return their structure including fields, types, and required status. If a url is provided, it navigates to that url first.
tools.name: detectForms

tools.description_excerpt: Click on an interactive element. Returns the current page URL and title after the click.
tools.name: click

tools.description_excerpt: Fill text into an input element. Returns the filled value and current page URL and title.
tools.name: fill

tools.description_excerpt: Scroll the page or a specific element. Returns the scroll position and current page URL and title.
tools.name: scroll

tools.description_excerpt: Wait for an element matching a CSS selector to appear in the frame. Returns the backend node ID of the matched element.
tools.name: waitForSelector

tools.description_excerpt: Hover over an element, triggering mouseover and mouseenter events. Useful for menus, tooltips, and hover states.
tools.name: hover

tools.description_excerpt: Press a keyboard key, dispatching keydown and keyup events. Use key names like 'Enter', 'Tab', 'Escape', 'ArrowDown', 'Backspace', or single characters like 'a', '1'.
tools.name: press

tools.description_excerpt: Select an option in a <select> dropdown element by its value. Dispatches input and change events.
tools.name: selectOption

tools.description_excerpt: Check or uncheck a checkbox or radio button. Dispatches input, change, and click events.
tools.name: setChecked

tools.description_excerpt: Find interactive elements by role and/or accessible name. Returns matching elements with their backend node IDs. Useful for locating specific elements without parsing the full semantic tree.
tools.name: findElement
